営む: to run (a business); to operate; to conduct
追う: to chase; to run after; to pursue; to follow after
組む: to unite; to join; to link up; to form an alliance
免れる: to avoid (e.g. punishment); to evade (e.g. responsibility); to avert; to elude
引き入れる: to win over; to entice into
被せる: to pin (e.g. a crime on someone); to lay (blame); to charge (with an offence)
奪う: to take (by force); to take away; to snatch; to steal
知れる: to be known; to be understood
結局: after all; in the end; ultimately; eventually
つく: to take (seat, position, course, office, etc.); to assume; to be hired; to be employed
元々: originally; from the start; from the beginning; from the outset
